meta.title: OAuth authorization manager
meta.description: Connect DSH to MCP servers that require OAuth 2.1: configure the server list, start an authorization and inspect the authorization state.

panel.title: OAuth authorization manager
panel.description: Configure the MCP servers that need OAuth authorization and inspect their authorization state.
panel.unavailable: The plugin configuration cannot be read right now.
panel.disconnected: This panel is not connected to the host configuration service: it cannot read the plugin configuration, so the server list below is empty.
panel.disconnected.hint: Open the host plugin configuration page to view or edit the servers, or run /oauth-mcp status in a chat to see the servers the plugin actually read.
panel.servers.title: MCP servers
panel.servers.empty: No MCP server is configured yet. Use “Add server” to start.
panel.servers.removeConfirm: Remove the server {name}? The stored credential is not deleted.
panel.field.label: Display name
panel.field.urlHttpHint: This address is plain HTTP, so the token travels in cleartext. The plugin works with it, but it only makes sense on your own network.
panel.field.clientIdHint: Leave empty to try dynamic registration; it is required when the server does not support it.
panel.field.clientSecretHint: Fill this in only when the vendor asks for a secret. The value goes into the plugin configuration first; after the authorization the plugin copies it into the credential record, and the copy in the configuration can be cleared.
panel.error.refused: The host refused the change; check the server id and the address.
panel.hint.runtimeStatus: This panel shows the configuration only: “Enabled” means the plugin tries to connect that server automatically. For the live state — authorized, connected, number of mirrored tools — use the /oauth-mcp status command or the dsh_oauth_mcp_status tool in a chat.
panel.global.title: Global settings
panel.global.restartHint: Callback mode, callback port, callback path and the tool name prefix are edited in the host configuration file (Settings → General → Open configuration file); the host restarts this plugin afterwards.
panel.servers.vendorHint: Pick a vendor to fill in the endpoint, the scopes and the authorization server; pick “Custom” to type everything yourself.
panel.field.idHint: Lower case letters, digits, underscores and dashes only.
panel.field.urlHint: The MCP endpoint, for example https://example.com/mcp.
panel.field.scopesHint: Comma separated, for example read,write. Empty means the default scopes.
panel.field.authorizationServerUrlHint: Leave empty to discover it with the MCP metadata rules.
panel.global.defaultScopesHint: Used when a server does not name its own scopes. Comma separated.
panel.servers.copyFailed: Copying failed, copy this command yourself:

toolview.authorize.awaiting: Open the link below in your browser and finish the login there. The authorization then returns to the local callback address.

server.table.label: Label
server.table.empty: No MCP server is configured yet.
server.tooltable.caption: {label} ({state}, {count} tools)
server.authorize.open: Open this link in your browser to authorize "{label}":
server.authorize.copy: If the link does not open, copy this line into the browser address bar:
server.authorize.done: When it finishes, the plugin saves the credential and connects the server (callback mode: {mode}).
server.authorize.status: Run "/oauth-mcp status" at any time to see the result.
server.authorize.manual: If the browser ends on a 127.0.0.1 page that cannot be loaded, copy the whole address bar URL back (you can paste it into the chat); the plugin uses it to finish the authorization.
server.help.heading: Usage:
server.help.status: oauth-mcp status [serverId]            show the state of every server
server.help.tools: oauth-mcp tools [serverId]             show the tools you get after authorizing (the names to call)
server.help.authorize: oauth-mcp authorize <serverId | url>   authorize a server (an unknown url is added on the spot)
server.help.complete: oauth-mcp complete <serverId> <url>    finish the authorization with the callback URL from the address bar
server.help.disconnect: oauth-mcp disconnect <serverId>         disconnect (the credential is kept)
server.help.cancel: oauth-mcp cancel <serverId>             cancel an authorization in flight
server.status.empty: No MCP server is configured yet.
server.status.empty.hint: Send the MCP address of a server and it gets connected, for example:
server.status.empty.vendors: The known vendors and their default scopes are listed in docs/vendors.md.
server.status.credentials.warning: ⚠ The host exposes no credential service (credentials), so the plugin cannot store the token.
server.status.credentials.restart: Restart DSH (or enable the credential plugin in the host) and authorize again.
server.status.next: Next step (servers that are not authorized yet):
server.status.pending: {label}: the authorization is in progress, continue here → [Open the authorization page](<{url}>)
server.tools.notfound: No MCP server with the id "{serverId}" was found.
server.tools.empty: No MCP server is configured yet.
server.tools.hint: Authorize a server and its tools show up here:
server.tools.usage.1: · Describe what you want in the chat; the agent picks the right tool;
server.tools.usage.2: · Or call one by name, for example "search my projects with mcp_oauth__notion__search".
server.tools.usage.3: · The tools are registered in the host, so the agent does not need to mention "MCP" or the server name.
server.authorize.usage:
Usage: oauth-mcp authorize <serverId | server URL>
Example: oauth-mcp authorize https://mcp.notion.com/mcp
server.complete.usage: Usage: oauth-mcp complete <serverId> <the whole URL from the browser address bar>
server.complete.done: "{label}" is authorized; the plugin saved the credential and started connecting.
server.disconnect.done: Disconnected "{serverId}" (the credential is kept and reconnects automatically).
server.cancel.done: Cancelled the authorization in flight for "{serverId}".
server.cancel.none: No authorization is in flight for "{serverId}".
server.unknown: Unknown command "{action}". Run "oauth-mcp help" to see the usage.
server.error.not_connected: The MCP server "{serverId}" is not connected.
server.error.unknown_server: No MCP server is configured with id "{serverId}".
server.error.not_authorized_yet: The MCP server "{serverId}" is not authorized yet.
server.error.web_unavailable: The host web server is unavailable.
server.error.no_authorization_url: The authorization server did not return an authorization URL.
server.error.state_mismatch: The state does not match a pending authorization request.
server.error.server_not_given: No MCP server was given: pass the id of a configured server or its endpoint URL.
server.error.endpoint_hint: You can also pass the MCP endpoint URL directly, for example "https://mcp.notion.com/mcp".
server.error.endpoint_not_mcp: The endpoint "{endpoint}" does not look like an MCP endpoint and no id could be derived from it.
server.error.no_pending_authorization: No authorization request is pending for "{serverId}".
server.error.authorization_in_flight: "{serverId}" already has an authorization request in flight; finish or cancel it first.
server.tool.status.tools: Tools available right now (call them by these names):
server.tool.status.pending: Needs a new authorization: {servers}. Call dsh_oauth_mcp_authorize for those servers.
server.tool.status.credentials: The host exposes no credential service, so the plugin cannot store a grant. Restart DSH (or enable the credentials plugin in the host) and authorize again.
server.tool.authorize.waiting: The authorization of "{label}" is waiting for the user.
server.tool.authorize.open: Open this link and finish the login there: [open the authorization page](<{url}>)
server.tool.authorize.nolink: The authorization link could not be built; check the server entry and try again.
server.tool.authorize.copy: If the link does not open, copy this line into the browser: {url}
server.tool.authorize.done: The plugin stores the access token and connects the server by itself once the login is done; call dsh_oauth_mcp_status to confirm.
server.tool.authorize.manual: If the browser ends on a 127.0.0.1 page that cannot be loaded, ask the user to copy the whole address bar URL and call this tool again with callbackUrl set to that URL.
server.tool.authorize.authorized: "{label}" is authorized and its tools are available to the host now. Call dsh_oauth_mcp_status to see the state of every server.
server.tool.authorize.cancelled: The authorization of "{label}" was cancelled. Nothing was stored.
server.tool.authorize.plan: Authorization plan for "{label}" ({serverId}). No request was sent to the server.
server.tool.authorize.redirect.manual: manual-only (the user pastes the callback URL back)
server.tool.authorize.next: Nothing was sent to the server; call this tool again without dryRun to start the login.
server.tool.authorize.next.done: Nothing left to do; the tools of the server are available to the host.
server.tool.authorize.next.ask: Ask the user to open the returned link and finish the login; the plugin stores the token and connects the server by itself.
server.tool.authorize.need.reference: Pass the id or the endpoint URL of the MCP server, or a callbackUrl of a finished login.
server.tool.authorize.need.endpoint: The endpoint "{endpoint}" does not look like an MCP endpoint and no server id could be derived from it.
server.tool.authorize.callback.unreadabl: The callback URL could not be read: the authorization server reported "{reason}". Ask the user to copy the whole address bar URL of the callback page.
server.tool.authorize.callback.unmatched: This callback does not match a pending authorization request. Start the authorization again and paste the new address bar URL.
server.tool.steps.registered: The plugin adds "{label}" ({url}) to the configured servers.
server.tool.steps.metadata: The plugin reads the OAuth protected-resource metadata of "{label}" ({url}).
server.tool.steps.server: The plugin discovers the authorization server and registers an OAuth client, or reuses the configured client id.
server.tool.steps.request: The plugin builds an authorization request with PKCE (S256), the resource indicator "{resource}" and the scopes: {scopes}.
server.tool.steps.redirect: The authorization server redirects to {redirectUri} (callback mode: {callbackMode}).
server.tool.steps.manual: The user opens the authorization link, signs in and copies the resulting callback URL back into the chat.
server.tool.steps.browser: The user opens the authorization link, signs in there and finishes the login.
server.tool.steps.exchange: The plugin exchanges the authorization code for an access token and stores it in the credential store.
server.tool.steps.connect: The plugin connects to the MCP server and registers its tools with the host.
server.tool.steps.pasted: The user finished the login in the browser and pasted the callback URL.
server.tool.steps.exchanged: The plugin exchanged the authorization code for an access token and stored it.
server.tool.steps.connected: The plugin connected the MCP server and registered its tools with the host.
error.discovery_failed: Could not discover the OAuth protected-resource metadata of this MCP server; check the server URL and network reachability.
error.metadata_invalid: The server returned incomplete or malformed OAuth metadata, so the authorization flow cannot continue.
error.issuer_mismatch: The issuer of the authorization server does not match the requested URL; the flow was stopped so credentials are never sent to the wrong server.
error.registration_failed: Dynamic client registration failed; create a client manually and fill in the client_id.
error.registration_unsupported: This authorization server does not support dynamic client registration; create a client manually and fill in the client_id.
error.token_exchange_failed: Exchanging the authorization code for an access token failed; start the authorization again.
error.token_refresh_failed: Refreshing the access token failed; a new authorization is required.
error.invalid_grant: The authorization code or refresh token is no longer valid; start the authorization again.
error.pkce_unsupported: This server does not support PKCE and cannot be integrated safely; use a server that supports PKCE.
error.state_invalid: The authorization callback failed validation and was rejected; start the authorization again.
error.state_expired: The authorization request expired; start the authorization again.
error.authorization_timeout: Waiting for the authorization callback timed out; start the authorization again and finish the login in time.
error.authorization_in_flight: This server already has an authorization request in flight; finish or cancel it first.
error.callback_rejected: The authorization callback was rejected; start the authorization again.
error.callback_conflict: The callback port is busy or the callback handling conflicted; switch to the manual callback paste mode.
error.mcp_unauthorized: The MCP server rejected the current credentials; a new authorization is required.
error.mcp_forbidden: The MCP server considers the granted scopes insufficient; add the missing scope in the server settings and authorize again.
error.mcp_protocol_error: The protocol exchange with the MCP server failed; check the server log.
error.mcp_transport_error: The connection to the MCP server dropped; check the URL and the network, then retry.
error.network_error: The network request failed; check connectivity and the server URL.
error.server_not_found: No such server; check the server id.
error.user_confirmation_required: This operation needs a confirmation from the user; complete it on the settings page.
error.not_authorized: This server is not authorized yet; start an authorization first.
error.credential_service_unavailable: The host exposes no credential service, so the token cannot be stored; restart DSH (or enable the credential plugin) and authorize again.
error.authorization_failed: The authorization did not complete; start it again.
error.access_denied: The authorization server rejected the request, usually because the user did not consent.
error.invalid_request: The authorization server considers the request incomplete or altered.
error.unsupported_response_type: The authorization server does not support the response type the plugin asked for.
error.server_error: The authorization server failed internally and cannot serve the request.
error.temporarily_unavailable: The authorization server is temporarily unavailable; retry later.
error.invalid_client: The authorization server does not know this client; check the client id and the client secret.
error.callback_method_not_allowed: The callback address answers GET requests only.
error.callback_invalid_host: The callback request did not come from the loopback interface.
error.callback_path_not_found: The callback path does not exist.
error.callback_forbidden: The callback request did not pass the origin check.
error.callback_failed: The callback could not be processed; start the authorization again.
callback.success.title: Authorization complete
callback.success.heading: Authorization complete
callback.success.lead: The server is connected and its tools are ready to use.
callback.success.hint: You can close this tab and return to DSH.
callback.error.title: Authorization failed
callback.error.heading: Authorization failed
callback.error.code.label: Error code:
callback.error.hint: You can close this tab and return to DSH.
error.access_denied.next: You declined this authorization; start it again whenever you are ready.
error.state_invalid.next: This authorization request expired or was replaced by another one; start the authorization again.
error.invalid_request.next: The request was incomplete or truncated; start the authorization again.
error.unsupported_response_type.next: The authorization server does not support this response type; use another server or contact its vendor.
error.server_error.next: The authorization server is temporarily unavailable; try again in a moment.
error.temporarily_unavailable.next: The authorization server is temporarily unavailable; try again in a moment.
error.invalid_client.next: The client credentials are invalid; check the client id and client secret configuration.
error.authorization_failed.next: The authorization did not complete; start it again.
error.callback_failed.next: The callback could not be processed; start the authorization again.
error.callback_method_not_allowed.next: The callback address answers GET requests only; check that the address is not mistyped.
error.callback_invalid_host.next: The callback request did not come from the loopback interface; check the callback address in the plugin settings.
error.callback_path_not_found.next: The callback path does not exist; check the callback path in the plugin settings.
error.callback_forbidden.next: The callback request did not pass the origin check; start the authorization again.
error.credential_service_unavailable.nex: The host exposes no credential service, so the plugin cannot store the token. Restart DSH (or enable the credentials plugin in the host) and start the authorization again.
error.discovery_failed.next: The OAuth metadata of the server could not be read; check the address and that the server is online.
error.metadata_invalid.next: The metadata the server published is not valid; contact its vendor.
error.issuer_mismatch.next: The issuer of the authorization server does not match the one it declares; the metadata was refused.
error.registration_failed.next: The dynamic registration failed; try again later or use a client of your own.
error.registration_unsupported.next: This vendor publishes no dynamic registration; create an OAuth app in its console and enter the client id in the panel.
error.token_exchange_failed.next: The token exchange failed; start the authorization again.
error.token_refresh_failed.next: The token could not be refreshed; a new authorization is needed.
error.invalid_grant.next: The authorization code or the refresh token is no longer valid; a new authorization is needed.
error.pkce_unsupported.next: This vendor supports no PKCE, so the plugin cannot complete the authorization the way OAuth 2.1 requires.
error.state_expired.next: The authorization request expired; start the authorization again.
error.authorization_cancelled.next: This authorization was cancelled; start it again whenever you are ready.
error.authorization_timeout.next: Waiting for the authorization callback timed out; start the authorization again and finish the login in time.
error.authorization_in_flight.next: This server already has an authorization request in flight; finish or cancel it first.
error.callback_rejected.next: This callback was rejected; start the authorization again.
error.callback_conflict.next: The callback port is taken; use the manual callback URL instead.
error.mcp_unauthorized.next: The MCP server refused the current credential; a new authorization is needed.
error.mcp_forbidden.next: The MCP server refused the request; the granted scopes may not cover it.
error.mcp_protocol_error.next: The answer of the MCP server is not valid; contact its vendor.
error.mcp_transport_error.next: The MCP server could not be reached; check the address and that the server is online.
error.network_error.next: The request failed; check the network and try again.
error.server_not_found.next: There is no such server; add it in the panel first.
error.user_confirmation_required.next: This step needs your confirmation; confirm it to continue.
error.not_authorized.next: This server is not authorized yet; start the authorization first.
error.default.next: Return to DSH and start the authorization again; if it keeps failing, check the plugin log.
